# TENSIX — Software, AI and Websites from Ahmedabad

> TENSIX (https://www.tensix.in/) is An independent software and AI studio in Navrangpura, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, founded and run by Hemal Shah. It builds websites, custom software and SaaS, AI agents and assistants, cloud and DevOps setups, email deliverability, data scraping and automation, and AI search visibility (GEO/AEO/SEO), at fixed prices in INR.
